relation: NO SEAT — the letters descent could not seat
note: The Demotic letters beyond fai — shai, khai (both dialectal glyphs), hori, djanja, shima, ti — carry NO value in any witness read: the witnesses' dash is unanimous. The Milesian grid arrived FULL (9/9/9 seats held); there was no vacant seat for a native letter to take except the one whose holder was dead (90). What the inheritance bought the language — a complete numeral system — is exactly what its own letters could not enter.

relation: PART of practice — devices, never letter values
note: Beyond 900 the witnesses show MARKS, not values: W1 (§Macrons and overlines, citing the Unicode Standard §7.3): ⲁ͵ = 1,000 (the numeral sign U+0375, Greek practice inherited) and the double overline U+033F (ⲁ̿ = 1,000), with the worked example ⲁ͵ⲱ̅ⲡ̅ⲏ̅ = 1,888. Satzinger prints a different device: a stauros sign at 1000, "Number only". Two devices in the record, both marks or symbols; no letter carries a thousands value in any source. Neither is seated; the engine's door counts marks and prices none.
